fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-03-28, around 14:55, the complainant contributed to a local chit group, and after the organiser failed to pay the maturity amount of Rs. 2,40,000, contact was lost, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-03-31. Rajesh Mani submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000409. The complaint refers to Dinesh Balan, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000363. The complainant alleged that Karthik Nathan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000383. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100071. The complainant mentioned digital documents and a bank transaction reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chit contributions reportedly collected in cash and through transfers.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, receiving account, afternoon, bank reference, digital document, associate, mobile number
